sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:58

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:58:1
items.html:
Two Malchuts, the Malchut of the male and the Malchut of the female, in two vessels, which are called YH, as above, they being simple, without a filling: That is, that the records that remained of the lights of the ZON after their departure are the aspects of the Malchuts of the ZON; for a record is discerned as the aspect of the Malchut of the light that departed. And they are simple, without a filling, since a filling means the measure of coarseness in the screen that draws the measure of the level; and since the measure of their coarseness refined — which is why the lights departed, as above — they are therefore simple.
And you already know that the vessels are called letters. It was also explained above that in the Partzuf of Hochma there is a vessel dedicated to the male and a vessel dedicated to the female. And this is what he says, that the two Malchuts are in two vessels, which are called YH, they being simple, without a filling.
